वैल वैल, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विल), relating or
belonging to a hole or pit.
—वैल-स्थ, अम्, n.,
Ved. a pit, burying-place, (according to Sāy. on Ṛg-
veda 1. 133, 3. महा-वैलस्थे = सर्वैर् गन्तव्ये
महा-श्मशाने or नाग-लोके.)
—वैल-स्थान,
अम्, n., Ved. a place like a hole, a pit; a burying-
place.
—वैल-स्थानक, अम्, n., Ved. a pit.

वैलक्षण्य वैलक्षण्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-
लक्षण), contrariety, difference, disparity, oppo-
sition; पूर्वोक्त-वैलक्षण्येन, in opposition to
what was before stated.

वैलक्ष्य वैलक्ष्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-लक्ष),
absence of mark or characteristic; contrariety, re-
verse, inversion; the reverse of what is usual or
natural, unnaturalness, affectation; स-वैलक्ष्यम्,
affectedly, in a forced manner, unnaturally.

वैलोम्य वैलोम्य, अम्, n. (fr. वि-लोम),
contrariety, reverseness, opposition, oppositeness.

वैल्व वैल्व, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. विल्व), relating
or belonging to the Vilva tree; made of Vilva
wood; (अम्), n. the fruit of the Vilva or Ægle
Marmelos.
—वैल्व-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, made or con-
sisting of the Vilva or of its wood, &c.
